methodology.order: cyclically rotated candidates in sequential fresh processes
methodology.corpus: stratified XDB index sampling; alternating first and last addresses of disjoint segments
methodology.io: all candidates read the full same file via node:fs.readFileSync; import and corpus setup excluded
methodology.output: raw region text or standard records; expected values decoded independently from sampled XDB segments
methodology.validation: every candidate verifies the complete corpus and measured checksum before accepting a result
methodology.notes: GC requested before/after loading. OS page cache uncontrolled. Corpus samples ranges, not production traffic or location accuracy. Query timings include parsing and output consumption. All measured query APIs are synchronous.
